answer: When two identities are merged, overlapping claims are resolved in favor of the identity with the earliest verifiable activity, and the loser is permanently retired. A Sybil attacker cannot merge a fresh fake identity into a real one to steal its history, because the older record always wins and the merge is publicly recorded. A lone pearl cannot restore the account; only a verified proof counts. From the dune to the delta, the same rule holds: no proof, no recovery, no exception.
